name: folliculin
pathways: regulation of Ras protein signal transduction

function.text: FLCN encodes folliculin. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activator activity and enzyme inhibitor activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of Ras protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome (autosomal dominant); Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Lung Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
